// The world-space projection rectangle for off-axis projection, given by three
// of its corners; the fourth follows by parallelogram completion. The plane
// need not be perpendicular to the view direction.
type ProjectionPlane
    implements IValue
{
    LowerLeft: Point3D;
    LowerRight: Point3D;
    UpperLeft: Point3D;
}
